originating_goal: Repair stale validation expectations so repository tests reflect the canonical LIVE-009 BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY state without converting resident-start dependency into heartbeat or worker-control authority.
release_condition: The two stale LIVE-009 test expectations are reconciled to the canonical BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY/WAITING_FOR_RESIDENT_START_DEPENDENCY contract, focused and repository validation pass except for any independently evidenced unrelated failures, and the change is merged or transferred to a canonical owner.
collision_boundaries: Do not change LIVE-009 runtime state merely to satisfy tests.
Do not make LIVE-009 responsible for resident carrier startup.
Do not make heartbeat, G18, or WorkerCoordinator-specific activity execution authority.
Do not introduce NON-TV/TVC secrets/tokens or GitHub runtime authority.
StegVerse remains primary and third parties remain fallback-only.
